diff --git a/src/review/show.test.ts b/src/review/show.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bb92d63
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/review/show.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { describe, it } from "vite-plus/test";
+import { parseUnifiedDiff } from "../git/diff.ts";
+import { numberedPatch } from "./show.ts";
+
+describe("numberedPatch", () => {
+  it("prints old and new numbers before each line and keeps git's no-newline marker", () => {
+    const [file] = parseUnifiedDiff(
+      [
+        "diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt",
+        "--- a/a.txt",
+        "+++ b/a.txt",
+        "@@ -9,2 +9,2 @@ head",
+        " keep",
+        "-old",
+        "\\ No newline at end of file",
+        "+new",
+        "\\ No newline at end of file",
+        "",
+      ].join("\n"),
+    );
+    assert.ok(file);
+    assert.equal(
+      numberedPatch(file, file.hunks),
+      [
+        "diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt",
+        "--- a/a.txt",
+        "+++ b/a.txt",
+        "@@ -9,2 +9,2 @@ head",
+        " 9  9  keep",
+        "10    -old",
+        "      \\ No newline at end of file",
+        "   10 +new",
+        "      \\ No newline at end of file",
+        "",
+      ].join("\n"),
+    );
+  });
+});
